subject.title: memory flush never triggers when reserveTokensFloor equals contextWindow

question: What should OpenClaw do when `reserveTokensFloor + memoryFlush.softThresholdTokens` leaves no positive token gate for the active context window?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent fix changes operator config semantics and overlaps with adjacent compaction-budget policy work.

options.title: Centralize effective runtime clamp
options.body: Clamp only the effective memory-flush/preflight threshold or reserve used at runtime, keep existing config valid, and add focused tests plus docs for the derived behavior.

options.title: Validate and migrate config
options.body: Reject or doctor-fix oversized reserve-floor settings so runtime only sees canonical values, with a clearer but more explicit upgrade path for existing users.

options.title: Defer to budget-policy PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the broader reserve and soft-threshold policy in adjacent budget PRs.

recommendation.title: Centralize effective runtime clamp
recommendation.body: Clamp only the effective memory-flush/preflight threshold or reserve used at runtime, keep existing config valid, and add focused tests plus docs for the derived behavior.
